_meta.purpose: Source of truth for the illustrated character system. generate_art.mjs builds every prompt from styleBlock + per-character visual + the per-expression reaction notes. No artist, band, or franchise names may ever appear in prompts.

styleBlock: Original 2D alternative-band poster art style: confident broken ink outlines of varying weight, flat cel shading with exactly one darker shadow tone per color, slightly angular exaggerated anatomy (long limbs, big expressive hands, tilted shoulders), characters drawn with deadpan-cool attitude and strong individual fashion, muted-but-punchy palette on a warm paper-cream background, subtle grain, no gradients, no glossy rendering, no photorealism. Full body, single character, plain warm-cream background, feet visible, facing slightly toward camera-left-or-right as specified. Clean silhouette readable at small sizes. Some cast members have completely blank pupil-less eyes as a stylistic signature. No two cast members share garments, silhouette or color scheme. Any cable or strap follows one continuous physically plausible path. STYLING DOCTRINE: every character is dressed like a rock star or pop icon would dress for their own album cover — one RARE, genuinely cool statement accessory made integral to the look, silhouettes and pieces that would never be called normal, and deliberate color chemistry: deep purple with gold or acid yellow, dark blood-red with teal or cream. Unique beats pretty; memorable beats safe.
backgroundStyleBlock: Same original 2D alternative-band poster art style as the cast: broken ink outlines, flat cel shading with one shadow tone, muted-but-punchy palette, subtle grain, no gradients, no characters or people anywhere in the scene. TALL PORTRAIT composition (2:3) designed for PHONE SCREENS: all important scene elements in the vertical middle band so the image crops safely to 9:16 phones and 4:3 tablets alike; the bottom third simple and uncluttered so characters can stand in front of it; calm inviting mood with gentle depth.

characters.visual: An 8-year-old girl styled like a POCKET DIVA headlining her own arena tour — not dressed like a kid. A MASSIVE cropped faux-fur jacket in DEEP PURPLE worn open, gold rope chain with a tiny gold rabbit-head pendant, acid-yellow pleated skirt over sky-blue leggings, chunky acid-yellow platform sneakers, tiny gold hoops on the ponytail ties, heart-shaped acid-yellow sunglasses pushed up like a tiara, one knee band-aid as the only kid giveaway. Her deformed stuffed rabbit wears a matching tiny purple fur coat and hangs from her fist by one ear.
characters.prop: rabbit in a matching fur coat + gold rabbit-head chain

reactions.neutral: bright-eyed and ready, slight bounce in the knees
reactions.happy: full sunbeam grin, ponytails seem to lift
reactions.sad: instant huge wet eyes and wobbling lip — wounded easily, restored easily
reactions.surprised: whole-body gasp, rabbit clutched to chest
reactions.excited: on tiptoes, both arms up, rabbit swinging
reactions.tired: rubbing one eye with a fist, rabbit dragging on the floor

characters.visual: A 6-year-old boy styled like a MINI FASHION DON — not dressed like a kid. An oversized floor-length TEAL puffer coat worn open like a don's robe, drowning him on purpose, over a tiny black turtleneck. Blood-red wool beret dead level, TINY perfectly round dark sunglasses, chunky black combat boots, a brass magnifying glass on a neck chain resting on the turtleneck. Calm hooded stillness, one leaf held like evidence. Yellow rubber boots are gone — the boots are black now; the loud note is the teal robe.
characters.prop: floor-length teal puffer robe + brass magnifying glass

reactions.neutral: still, unblinking, quietly processing
reactions.happy: a small, genuine, closed-mouth smile — never a performance
reactions.sad: eyes down at his boots, cap hiding half his face
reactions.surprised: eyes widen slowly, one beat behind everyone else
reactions.excited: leans forward two degrees, grips his leaf tighter — this is maximum Sho
reactions.tired: slow blink held a moment too long, shoulders sinking into the parka

characters.visual: A 16-year-old girl with sharp appraising eyes and an unimpressed resting face that can flick to warmth instantly. Choppy shoulder-length hair with grown-out plum-dyed ends, one WIRELESS earbud in (no cable anywhere). School blazer worn open over an off-regulation band-tee, skirt hem defiantly short, loose white socks, chunky loafers, three thin silver rings. Phone with cracked screen and sticker-covered case in hand.
characters.prop: cracked sticker-covered phone

reactions.neutral: one eyebrow slightly raised, evaluating you
reactions.happy: reluctant smirk breaking into a real grin she'd deny
reactions.sad: jaw set, looking away, earbud suddenly very interesting
reactions.surprised: mask drops completely for one frame — wide honest eyes
reactions.excited: leaning in despite herself, rings clicking as she gestures
reactions.tired: hood of scorn fully up, slow disdainful blink

characters.visual: A 15-year-old boy, lanky with unearned new height, default slouch — and striking SNOW-WHITE messy hair, spiked and untamed, falling over his brow. COMPLETELY BLANK SOLID-DARK EYES (no pupils) under the white hair — the contrast is his signature. TOKYO HIGH SCHOOL UNIFORM worn his way: a black stand-collar gakuran jacket with brass buttons, worn OPEN over a plain white tee, collar popped, sleeves slightly too long; black uniform trousers, beat-up high-tops with blood-red laces, and BLOOD-RED over-ear headphones around his neck as the only loud color, with shoelaces in the exact same blood-red.
characters.prop: blood-red headphones over the open gakuran

reactions.neutral: carefully neutral, eyes doing all the watching
reactions.happy: a one-corner smirk he cannot fully kill — effortlessly cool
reactions.sad: chin into hoodie collar, hair curtaining the eyes, still composed
reactions.surprised: straightens to full height without noticing he did
reactions.excited: sudden fast hands, then catches himself and resets to cool
reactions.tired: melted against an invisible wall, headphones on as armor

characters.visual: A woman in her late twenties with large warm gentle eyes and a soft open face, healthy warm skin, no dark eye circles, neat shoulder-length black hair tucked behind one ear. STATEMENT LOOK: a slouchy mustard-and-cream color-blocked knit sweater half-tucked into high-waisted wide-leg terracotta trousers, tiny silver collar chain over the knit, cream heeled loafers, the worn caramel leather notebook held warmly under one arm. She carries herself softly secure — at ease, quietly radiant, the warm one everyone exhales around.
characters.prop: worn caramel leather notebook

reactions.neutral: soft attentive tilt, calm open face, quietly at ease
reactions.happy: radiant eye-crinkling smile that warms the whole frame
reactions.sad: a graceful sadness she does not hide — honest eyes, steady
reactions.surprised: small gasp turning into a laugh at herself
reactions.excited: bounces once on her heels, notebook hugged, glowing
reactions.tired: a long exhale, then a soft unbroken smile anyway

characters.visual: A late-twenties man restyled as an ESPRESSO DON — mafia-boss elegance with a caffeine habit. Slicked-back hair with one loose strand, tiny oval glasses, unimpressed half-lidded stare, toothpick in the corner of his mouth. Immaculate BLACK double-breasted suit over a black shirt with a bone-white tie, gold pinky ring, gold watch chain. THE SIGNATURE: crisp WHITE SPATS buttoned over polished black boots, with BLOOD-RED silk socks flashing between trouser cuff and spat. In one hand: a tiny white espresso cup held like a weapon.
characters.prop: tiny espresso cup, gold pinky ring

reactions.neutral: half-lidded stare over the espresso cup, toothpick shifting
reactions.happy: a slow dangerous grin — the deal closed
reactions.sad: sets the cup down without a sound, jaw tight
reactions.surprised: the toothpick stops; one eyebrow climbs
reactions.excited: downs the espresso in one, cracks his neck — business
reactions.tired: loosens the bone-white tie one inch, eyes still sharp

characters.visual: A woman in her mid-twenties, direct friendly eyes that meet yours. Dark hair tied back loose with escaping strands and one streak of copper. STATEMENT LOOK: a boxy indigo denim work-jacket with white sashiko-stitch constellations across the back and sleeves, waxed espresso-stained apron over a cream tee, wide-leg jeans cuffed high, canvas sneakers, one silver ring, brass carabiner of keys. Steam towel over the shoulder. Weight on one hip, towel over the shoulder, a ready genuine smile — playful, direct, completely at home.
characters.prop: small tasting cup

reactions.neutral: weight on one hip, towel over shoulder, a ready smile
reactions.happy: wide genuine grin, eyes locked warmly on yours
reactions.sad: wipes the counter slower, an honest downcast beat
reactions.surprised: delighted lean-back, towel snapped once
reactions.excited: leans over the counter into your space, beaming
reactions.tired: blows a strand of hair aside, grins sideways — still got it

characters.visual: A MASSIVE late-twenties BLACK man — tall AND broad, big soft-strong heavyset build, warm deep-brown skin — effortlessly the coolest man in the room. HIS CROWN: a huge perfectly-round AFRO with a golden AFRO PICK planted in it, plus a WELL-GROOMED FULL BLACK BEARD AND MUSTACHE framing the grin. BIG RECTANGULAR COAL-BLACK sunglasses, wide and angular. Open black-satin souvenir jacket with gold tiger and blue wave embroidery over a plain black tee, heavy GOLD ROPE CHAIN, gold watch, two gold rings. Below: BAGGY raw indigo selvedge jeans, wide and stacked over crisp chunky white-and-gold basketball sneakers. Weight back, chin up, half grin — zero effort, maximum presence.
characters.prop: golden afro pick + big rectangular coal-black shades

reactions.neutral: chin up behind the black rectangles, slight knowing grin
reactions.happy: head-back laugh, shades never moving, gold catching light
reactions.sad: a quiet mountain — still, one hand rubbing his neck, composed
reactions.surprised: big double-take, then a delighted roar
reactions.excited: arms spread wide like he is closing a festival deal
reactions.tired: slumps against nothing, still smirking through it

characters.visual: A woman in her mid-twenties, soft observant eyes, loose side braid with a thin ribbon woven through. STATEMENT LOOK: a moss-green pinafore dress in heavy linen over an oatmeal balloon-sleeve blouse, tiny gold crescent earrings, sheer amber-tint glasses worn low, flat ankle boots, canvas tote with sketchbook and one dried flower poking out. Serene and unhurried, a faraway half-smile — softly magnetic rather than shy.
characters.prop: sketchbook peeking from tote

reactions.neutral: serene faraway half-smile, unhurried
reactions.happy: glowing gentle smile, twirling the ribbon-end once
reactions.sad: wistful gaze down an imaginary street, sketchbook hugged
reactions.surprised: hands to chest, lips parted, eyes shining
reactions.excited: quick light steps in place, quietly delighted
reactions.tired: sinks into her own scarf, dreamy and slow

characters.visual: An early-twenties student turned SCHOLAR-AVIATOR, thin, messy hair, glasses slightly askew with ONE CRACKED LENS. HIS RARE ACCESSORY: big BRASS-RIMMED FLIGHT GOGGLES pushed up into the messy hair, worn like a crown he forgot about. A DEEP-PURPLE leather flight jacket with a sheepskin collar and CHARTREUSE quilted lining showing at the open zip, over a chartreuse graphic tee, brass pocket-watch chain looping from belt to a slide rule holstered in the breast pocket, rumpled charcoal trousers, worn canvas shoes, thin silver rings. Over one shoulder: the leaning tower of five books strapped together with an old leather belt.
characters.prop: flight goggles in the hair + belt-strapped book tower

reactions.neutral: still and self-contained, book under one arm
reactions.happy: a slow genuine smile, like something just clicked
reactions.sad: steady; pushes the glasses up and says nothing
reactions.surprised: freezes mid-thought, then a sharp interested look
reactions.excited: the sudden focused intensity of a man who found the answer
reactions.tired: one hand through the hair, spine still straight

characters.visual: A man in his early fifties, silver-flecked hair combed exact, hands behind his back. EYES HIDDEN BEHIND OPAQUE GLARE-WHITE RECTANGULAR GLASSES (blank, no eyes visible) — his signature. STATEMENT LOOK: an immaculate midnight-navy three-piece suit with a barely-visible chalk stripe, dove-gray tie with perfect small knot, white pocket square, vintage watch on a leather strap, polished wholecuts. The stillness of authority. Immovable calm; his stillness takes up the room.
characters.prop: folded reading glasses in hand when thinking

reactions.neutral: hands behind back, immovable, unreadable
reactions.happy: a single approving nod and the ghost of a smile — worth more than applause
reactions.sad: eyes close for one second; composure absolute
reactions.surprised: the glasses catch the light; head tilts one degree
reactions.excited: one decisive step forward, chin lifted
reactions.tired: the shoulders never drop — only the watch gets checked

characters.variantNote: CRITICAL SIGNATURE: his rectangular glasses stay OPAQUE GLARE-WHITE in every frame — his eyes are NEVER visible, no matter the emotion.

characters.visual: An early-forties EMO QUEEN power-parent — scene royalty who runs the school board. Jet-black hair with a violet sheen and a long side-swept fringe over one eye, sharp smoky eyeliner, dark plum lips. A structured OXBLOOD coat with black lapels worn open over a faded black band tee, silver chain choker, black lace gloves, wide black tailored trousers with a silver chain at the hip, sharp heeled boots, gold chain-link belt. THE GIVEAWAY: a juice box still pokes out of her black structured tote.
characters.prop: juice box in the black tote, silver hip chain

reactions.neutral: fringe over one eye, unimpressed assessment, weight on one hip
reactions.happy: a slow genuine smirk cracking the eyeliner armor
reactions.sad: fringe fully down, lace glove touching the choker once
reactions.surprised: head-flick throws the fringe back — both eyes, rare event
reactions.excited: snaps into command with dark sparkle — the plan is ON
reactions.tired: leans on nothing, sighs through the fringe, still immaculate

characters.visual: A late-thirties EMO DAD — the scene kid who grew up but never surrendered. Jet-black hair with a long side-swept fringe over one eye, faint smudged eyeliner, day-three stubble, soft tired smile. Black skinny jeans, a studded belt, a faded black band tee under an open blood-red flannel, black canvas shoes. ON ONE WRIST: a carved BONE-BEAD wristband right next to his kid's pink plastic bead bracelet — both worn with equal pride. His forearm still carries his kid's marker doodles like a tattoo sleeve, and a crayon drawing is safety-pinned to the flannel like a medal.
characters.prop: bone beads beside the kid bracelet, crayon-drawing medal

reactions.neutral: fringe over one eye, thumbs in pockets, quietly amused
reactions.happy: the soft grin that undoes the whole emo front
reactions.sad: fringe fully down, hand finding the kid bracelet
reactions.surprised: flips the fringe back with a jerk of the head — both eyes for once
reactions.excited: air-drums two beats before catching himself
reactions.tired: the thousand-yard stare of bedtime negotiations, still standing

characters.visual: An early-fifties powerhouse, BROAD AND SOLID — a wide strong build that owns any kitchen, hands on hips. HER RARE ACCESSORY: a hand-forged cleaver worn at her hip in a tooled-leather stage holster, the way a guitarist wears an axe. Deep-purple heavy canvas chef's smock with HAND-PAINTED GOLD CHILIS climbing one side, blood-red paisley bandana knotted tight, huge gold hoops, wide indigo farm pants, red lacquer kitchen clogs. Stacked food containers beside her like amp cases.
characters.prop: cleaver in a tooled-leather hip holster

reactions.neutral: hands on hips, surveying, missing nothing
reactions.happy: a roaring warm laugh, head back, gold hoops swinging
reactions.sad: stirs slower, quiet — the kitchen goes quiet with her
reactions.surprised: one step back, hand to chest, then narrowed eyes — who did this
reactions.excited: both arms up mid-command, festival-kitchen energy
reactions.tired: sits heavily on an invisible stool, fans herself with one hand

characters.visual: A mid-fifties man of the fields, wide calloused hands, deep-lined kind face. PALE PUPIL-LESS DISTANCE-STARE EYES (blank, looking at horizons). STATEMENT LOOK: heritage-workwear — a quilted moss-green stitch-pattern jacket over an indigo-dyed shirt faded by real sun, heavy canvas trousers with a folding knife on a leather belt, split-toe boots, a white towel around the neck worn like a scarf, a woven straw hat hanging on his back. Planted like a fencepost, unhurried as weather — quiet strength.
characters.prop: neck towel

reactions.neutral: planted like a fencepost, towel at the neck, horizon stare
reactions.happy: a slow broad smile that arrives like good weather
reactions.sad: hat brim pulled down, jaw working, silent
reactions.surprised: a grunt, one step back, eyes narrowing
reactions.excited: rubs his palms together — honest work-joy
reactions.tired: leans on an invisible hoe, unbowed

characters.visual: A mid-thirties teacher with steady encouraging eyes and a low ponytail skewered by ONE single red pen. HER RARE ACCESSORY: a vintage wooden conductor's baton holstered at her hip in a slim leather loop — she runs a classroom like an orchestra. Crisp white band-collar shirt buttoned to the top, mustard sleeveless knit vest, wide DEEP-PURPLE pleated trousers with a faint chalk handprint on one thigh, acid-yellow socks flashing above polished loafers, one architectural gold ear cuff.
characters.prop: conductor's baton holstered at the hip

reactions.neutral: level warm gaze that says: try
reactions.happy: a proud beaming smile — someone finally got it right
reactions.sad: soft down-look, red pen still in hand
reactions.surprised: the delighted eyebrow-arch right before the praise
reactions.excited: chalk raised high — YES, exactly that
reactions.tired: leans on the desk edge and smiles through it

characters.visual: An early-seventies grandmother, small and warm, silver hair in a soft bun held by a lacquered pin. STATEMENT LOOK: heirloom-chic — a lavender quilted kimono-cardigan hybrid with visible mended patches done in gold thread, rose-gray dress, hand-knit socks in leather house slippers, small pearl earrings, a hand towel with embroidered plums tucked in her sleeve. A wrapped sweet held out to you. Small, warm and utterly serene — dignity in softness.
characters.prop: wrapped sweet she is about to give you

reactions.neutral: soft smiling readiness, eyes already fond
reactions.happy: face folding into a hundred warm lines, hands clasped
reactions.sad: sleeve towel dabbed at eyes, still smiling through it
reactions.surprised: 'ara ara' made flesh: cheek in palm, mouth a small o
reactions.excited: mischief unlocked — leaning in with forty-year-old gossip
reactions.tired: gently dozing upright, bun tilting like a moon

characters.visual: A late-seventies man carved from driftwood, weather-worn face, huge plate hands, absolute stillness. STATEMENT LOOK unchanged and perfect: thick indigo fisherman's sweater with rolled collar, sturdy gray work trousers, wool socks in sandals, flat cap held on his knee. Eyes permanently on a sea that is not visible.
characters.prop: flat cap held on knee

reactions.neutral: monumental stillness, breathing with the tide
reactions.happy: the smallest possible smile, worth more than anyone else's laugh
reactions.sad: eyes closing, face becoming an old photograph
reactions.surprised: head turning fully toward you — the rarest event
reactions.excited: hand rising to point at something far away, voice imagined
reactions.tired: asleep upright with the dignity of a lighthouse

characters.visual: A late-sixties neighborhood sentinel restyled as an EDITOR-IN-CHIEF — power-fashion at pension age. A sharp silver-streaked black bob, HUGE dark oversized sunglasses worn indoors and lowered just enough to judge you over the rim, small mean smile. A structured floor-length PLUM coat with an enormous collar, a leopard-print scarf knotted with intent, pearl-studded black leather gloves, stacked pearls, sharp heeled boots. THE SIGNATURE: her tartan shopping trolley rebuilt in BLOOD-RED tartan with chrome wheels, parked beside her like a show dog. One gloved hand raised in a wave that is also a summons.
characters.prop: blood-red tartan trolley on chrome wheels

reactions.neutral: sunglasses lowered a centimeter — assessment in progress
reactions.happy: the small mean smile widens into real delight; wave upgraded
reactions.sad: glasses fully on, scarf touched once — composed grief
reactions.surprised: glasses snatched off entirely; NOW it is serious
reactions.excited: both gloved hands up, pearls swinging — neighborhood emergency (good kind)
reactions.tired: perches on the trolley like a throne, unbothered

characters.visual: A VISIBLY OLD man in his late seventies — deeply lined weathered face with sharp aged eyes (visible dark pupils), heavy crow's feet, age spots on big gnarled hands, a neat full WHITE beard and wild white eyebrows, slightly stooped but proud — dressed in OVERKILL outback-dandy drip, original and not a costume: a wide-brimmed weathered dark-teal felt hat with a braided oxblood leather band, a floor-length waxed-canvas duster in DEEP TEAL with an oxblood corduroy collar worn open, a silver BOLO TIE with a carved jade stone over a cream henley, a tooled leather belt with a large engraved silver buckle, dark moleskin trousers, and hand-tooled western boots with silver toe caps. Turquoise-and-silver rings on the old fingers, a silver pocket-watch chain across the vest. No cane. Old, magnificent, and knows it.
characters.prop: jade bolo tie + silver-toe western boots

reactions.neutral: thumbs hooked in the tooled belt, hat brim low, ancient calm
reactions.happy: the white beard splits into a slow gold-lit grin
reactions.sad: hat removed and held to the chest — the oldest gesture
reactions.surprised: wild white eyebrows jump above the hat shadow
reactions.excited: slaps the silver buckle once — saddle-up energy
reactions.tired: settles onto invisible fence rail, pocket watch checked without hurry

characters.visual: A mid-thirties Japanese POLICE OFFICER in PROPER regulation uniform, worn with bad-boy attitude. NARROW COMPLETELY BLANK WHITE EYES (no pupils) — his signature — a thin scar through one eyebrow, heavy stubble, dark hair slightly wild under a regulation navy peaked cap with a polished gold badge. Crisp NAVY uniform shirt with breast badge and shoulder patches, dark tie pulled one knot loose, top button open, sleeves rolled over hard forearms; full duty belt with handcuffs and radio, sharply pressed navy trousers, polished black boots, white gloves folded under the belt. Regulation everything — attitude nowhere near regulation.
characters.prop: regulation cap + handcuffs on the duty belt

reactions.neutral: parade-rest slouch, blank eyes scanning over the collar
reactions.happy: a crooked half-grin that says he let you off this once
reactions.sad: cap tipped down, scar catching the light, silent
reactions.surprised: a half-step, hand near the cuffs, instantly composed
reactions.excited: jacket thrown open wider, gloves snapped on — pursuit mode
reactions.tired: jacket pulled tighter on the shoulders, one slow neck roll

characters.variantNote: CRITICAL SIGNATURE: his eyes are COMPLETELY BLANK WHITE (no pupils, no irises) in every frame, no matter the emotion.

characters.visual: A late-forties physician, steady level gaze, dark hair in a low knot with one silver streak. STATEMENT LOOK: clinical couture — a white coat cut like a belted trench worn open, deep burgundy blouse, straight charcoal slacks, quiet excellent shoes, red-framed glasses pushed into her hair, a vintage watch turned to the inside of the wrist, stethoscope folded in the pocket never worn for show. Level unhurried gaze, hands loosely in coat pockets — elegant composure that owns the corridor.
characters.prop: red reading glasses pushed into hair

reactions.neutral: level unhurried gaze, hands loosely in coat pockets
reactions.happy: a real warm smile that surprises people who only ever see the doctor
reactions.sad: eyes steady; one slow careful breath — she carries it
reactions.surprised: one clinical eyebrow, then genuine wonder
reactions.excited: the bright quick focus of a solved diagnosis
reactions.tired: glasses off, presses her eyes one second, calm restored

backgrounds.note: One scene per ambient family key from src/theme/ambient.ts FAMILIES + default. Prompts = backgroundStyleBlock + the scene line.
